title: The Meritocracy Myth
hook: Hard work isn't the variable that determines your income.
script:
(Visual: Fast cuts of a corporate office, a crowded metro, and a luxury car)
Voiceover: We are taught that Success = Talent + Hard Work. This is the meritocracy myth.
(Visual: Split screen. Left side: A person working 14 hours a day in a low-leverage role. Right side: A person making a single high-leverage decision.)
Voiceover: If hard work were the primary driver of wealth, the hardest working people in India would be the richest. But they aren’t.
(Visual: Text overlay: LEVERAGE > EFFORT)
Voiceover: The market doesn't pay for effort; it pays for the scarcity of the value you provide and the leverage you apply to it. 
(Visual: Close up to camera, serious expression)
Voiceover: Stop optimizing for "hard work" and start optimizing for "leverage."
caption: Your effort is a baseline, not a competitive advantage. In a global economy, the reward goes to those who solve rare problems at scale, not those who spend the most hours at their desk. Stop confusing activity with achievement. #RationalThoughts #FirstPrinciples #CareerStrategy #IndianProfessionals #MentalModels
